description: Implementation of USB transfer management functions for Zephyr OS, including transfer initiation, callback handling, and synchronization.

methods.name: usb_ep_get_transfer
methods.description: Retrieve the transfer data associated with a specific endpoint.

methods.name: usb_transfer_is_busy
methods.description: Check if a transfer on a specific endpoint is ongoing.

methods.name: usb_transfer_work
methods.description: Handle the transfer work, including reading/writing data and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: usb_transfer_ep_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon endpoint transfer events, triggers transfer work.

methods.name: usb_transfer
methods.description: Initiate a USB transfer (read/write) on a specified endpoint.

methods.name: usb_cancel_transfer
methods.description: Cancel an ongoing transfer on a specific endpoint.

methods.name: usb_transfer_sync_cb
methods.description: Callback for synchronous transfer completion, signals semaphore.

methods.name: usb_transfer_sync
methods.description: Perform a synchronous USB transfer, blocking until completion.

methods.name: usb_transfer_init
methods.description: Initialize transfer slots and work structures.
